programs.title: The 90-Day Postpartum Rebuild
programs.subtitle: Heal, reconnect, and rebuild your strength, gently and for good.

weeks.themeSubtitle: The original gentle week: reconnect with your core and your body.

days.title: Heal Your Core
days.intention: Today I recover after birth by being kind to my body and finding my deep core again.

days.title: Soothe New Mom Aches
days.intention: Today I recover after birth by easing the stiffness from holding and feeding.

days.title: Close The Gap
days.intention: Today I recover after birth by knitting my tummy muscles back together safely.

days.title: Reclaim Your Balance
days.intention: Today I recover after birth by finding my balance and feeling steady again.

days.title: Support Your Pelvis
days.intention: Today I recover after birth by building strong support around my pelvis.

days.title: Strength for Motherhood
days.intention: Today I recover after birth by teaching my body to lift, carry, and move with confidence.

days.title: Strong & Capable
days.intention: Today is a celebration. You have healed, connected, and rebuilt. We will put your new strength to work, so you feel capable in your recovering body.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Breath, circulation, and kind movement while your body heals.

days.title: Inner Reconnection
days.intention: A gentle squeeze today reminds your core how to support you again. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Let this be your time: no rush, no judgment, just practice.

days.title: Quiet Core Work
days.intention: Today's deep core work is slow and careful, closing the gap in your tummy muscles from the inside out. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Mother's Mobility
days.intention: Gentle joint circles and rolls today restore the easy movement your days demand. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: Bridge Builder
days.intention: Today's hip work gives your recovering core a powerful ally. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: Carry & Go
days.intention: Today's session makes the hardest parts of your day feel easier. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.

days.title: Strength Returns
days.intention: Today we add a little more. Proof of how much your body has healed. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. You are exactly where you need to be in this process.

days.title: Recovery Ritual
days.intention: Recovery is where your body absorbs the week's work, so give it room today. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Give yourself full credit for pressing play today.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Wake the deep abdominals that carried you through pregnancy.

days.title: Foundation Breath
days.intention: Today starts with your breath, the gentlest and strongest way to wake your deep core. We are building the habit now, with steady, repeatable, unhurried work. Trust the work. Your body is quietly getting stronger every session.

days.title: The Gentle Knit
days.intention: We train your deepest tummy muscle today, the corset that pulls everything back together. Your consistency this week wires in the connection we built earlier. Let this be your time: no rush, no judgment, just practice.

days.title: Undo the Day
days.intention: Today is mobility medicine for your back, hips, and shoulders. This phase is about switching on the right muscles at the right moment. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Strong Seat
days.intention: We wake up your glutes today so your back and floor stop overworking. We are building the habit now, with steady, repeatable, unhurried work. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: Everyday Power
days.intention: Today we train the exact moves motherhood asks for: lifting, lowering, and carrying safely. Your consistency this week wires in the connection we built earlier. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: New Baseline
days.intention: A fuller strength session today keeps your rebuild moving forward. This phase is about switching on the right muscles at the right moment. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.

days.title: Slow Sunday
days.intention: Let today feel like a long breath out: slow movement, deep breathing, no pressure. This phase is about switching on the right muscles at the right moment. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Free Your Spine

days.title: Pelvic Support Day

days.title: Stronger Chapter
days.intention: Today you train like the strong, recovering athlete you are. We are building the habit now, with steady, repeatable, unhurried work. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: Gentle Landing
days.intention: This restore day protects everything you built this week; sink into it. We are building the habit now, with steady, repeatable, unhurried work. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.
